_comment: Window title patterns (case-insensitive substring match) that block screen_process from sending a screenshot to Groq/Gemini. If the target window's title (or the frontmost window's title, when no specific app is named) contains any pattern below, FRIDAY declines and tells you why instead of capturing and sending it. Add or remove entries any time — this file is re-read whenever it changes, no restart needed. One pattern per entry; matches anywhere in the title, e.g. 'chase' matches 'Chase Bank - Sign In - Google Chrome'.
